# Security policy

This is a fork of [terraforming-mars/terraforming-mars](https://github.com/terraforming-mars/terraforming-mars)
with a reworked user interface.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue. Report it privately instead:
**Security → Report a vulnerability** in this repository
([direct link](https://github.com/wrybit/terraforming-mars/security/advisories/new)).

If the problem also exists in the original project, it is fixed here and proposed there as a pull request.

## Supported versions

Only the current state of the `main` branch is maintained.
